cards.card_text: Then Jacob says Dan will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horse's heels.
cards.verse_text: He will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.
cards.snippet: He will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider…

cards.card_text: He says He'll heap disasters on them: hunger, plague, wild beasts, vipers, the sword outside and terror inside.
cards.verse_text: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.
cards.snippet: …send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.

cards.card_text: Then Zophar says the wicked man will suck the poison of cobras, and the fangs of a viper will kill him.
cards.verse_text: He will suck the poison of cobras; the fangs of a viper will kill him.
cards.snippet: He will suck the poison of cobras; the fangs of a viper will kill him.

cards.card_text: He says there's venom of vipers on them.
cards.verse_text: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips.
cards.snippet: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips.

cards.card_text: "In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper." It's like a cookie that's golden on top, then you flip it over and the bottom is BLACK.
cards.verse_text: In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.
cards.snippet: In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.

cards.card_text: A viper A lion A bear
cards.verse_text: For a viper will spring from the root of the snake, and a flying serpent from its egg.
cards.snippet: For a viper will spring from the root of the snake, and a flying serpent…

cards.card_text: Next comes a burden against the beasts of the Negev, the southern desert: a trip through a land of hardship and distress, of lions, vipers and FLYING serpents.
cards.verse_text: This is the burden against the beasts of the Negev: Through a land of hardship and distress, of lioness and lion, of viper and flying serpent, they carry their wealth on the backs of donkeys and their treasures on the humps of camels, to a people of no profit to them.
cards.snippet: …Through a land of hardship and distress, of lioness and lion, of viper and flying serpent, they carry their wealth on the backs of donkeys…

cards.card_text: Then Isaiah grabs two pictures: they hatch viper eggs and weave a spider's web, and friend, nobody's cracking THOSE eggs into the cookie dough.
cards.verse_text: They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web.
cards.snippet: They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web.

cards.card_text: What does Isaiah say happens to whoever eats those viper eggs?
cards.verse_text: They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web.
cards.snippet: They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web.

cards.verse_text: “For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the LORD.
cards.snippet: “For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the LORD.

cards.card_text: God says He will send vipers among His people.
cards.verse_text: “For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the LORD.
cards.snippet: “For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the LORD.

cards.card_text: You brood of vipers You honored teachers You faithful shepherds
cards.verse_text: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
cards.snippet: …to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

cards.card_text: Then Jesus says to the Pharisees, “You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good?”
cards.verse_text: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good?
cards.snippet: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good?

cards.card_text: Jesus says, "Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your fathers." Then He calls them snakes, a brood of vipers.
You brood of vipers You sons of thunder You stiff-necked people
cards.verse_text: Then John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
cards.snippet: …the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

cards.verse_text: Paul gathered a bundle of sticks, and as he laid them on the fire, a viper, driven out by the heat, fastened itself to his hand.
cards.snippet: …bundle of sticks, and as he laid them on the fire, a viper, driven out by the heat, fastened itself to his hand.

cards.card_text: Then the quotes zoom in on the body: their throats are open graves, their tongues practice deceit, and the venom of vipers is on their lips.
cards.verse_text: “Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.” “Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness.”
cards.snippet: “Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.” “Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness.”
